description:
Stop a booking's no-show recovery so no further follow-up is scheduled. A follow-up already being sent may still arrive. Send recovery.id as recoveryCaseId and recovery.outcomeVersion from luca_bookings_recovery_get; a recovery that changed since that read returns 409 booking_recovery_changed.

Luca operation: POST /api/bookings/{id}/recovery/stop
Required scopes: bookings:write
Required OAuth scope: luca:queue_ops; data sensitivity: redacted
Requires Idempotency-Key. Provide idempotencyKey for safe retries, or the server will generate one.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe retries. If omitted, the MCP server generates a unique key for this call.

name: luca_bookings_recovery_stop
title: Stop a no-show recovery
